title: Ema Datshi
description: Ema Datshi is a Bhutan dish made with bird's eye chili, garlic, tomato, cheddar cheese. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Cheddar substitutes for Bhutanese datshi cheese; heat gently to avoid splitting.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 8 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 12 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
